title: Derived-unit naturality on the canonical cycle map
statement: Let C,D and additive S:C \to D have derived categories and the injective hypotheses of [src-right-derived-functor-plus-compatibility]. Let K be a cochain complex, n any integer, M in D+(C), and q:QK \to inclusion(M). The canonical lift of S(iCycles(K,n)), followed by homologyπ of S(K), inverse localization/homology comparison, homology of the actual unbounded derived unit, homology of RS(q), and homology of inverse bounded-below/unbounded compatibility at M equals the actual single-object unit on cycles_n(K) of [new-lem-pc-derived-single-shift-normalization], followed by degree-n homology of R+S applied to the fully faithful preimage of cyclesDerivedMap(K,n) followed by q [new-lem-pc-derived-cycles-map-homology]. No left exactness or concentration hypothesis on M is needed.

source.place: 05TC (2), canonical double truncation; 05TD (3), actual derived unit. Canonical-map calculation written by R2 from the parent node and the named library comparisons.

proof.text: The defining rightDerivedNatTrans_app equation for the inverse uniqueness comparison proves that bounded-below/unbounded compatibility intertwines the actual units. On the single object the quotient/single preimage is the identity; the coefficient-functor single comparison is Q of the corresponding chain isomorphism.

The mapped cycle chain map factors through the cycle chain map of S(K) by the canonical liftCycles. Prove this in degree n by from_single_hom_ext and liftCycles_i. Apply the proved cycle-map homology formula and naturality of the single/homology comparison.

Naturality of the unbounded derived unit for the cycle chain map, followed by q, and naturality of inverse compatibility give equality with the bounded-below actual single unit. Apply homology, substitute the preceding mapped-cycle calculation, and unfold rightDerivedPlusSingleUnitHomologyAt.

theorem rightDerived_cycles_unit_naturality (n : ℤ) (K : CochainComplex C ℤ)
    (M : DerivedCategory.Plus C) (q : DerivedCategory.Q.obj K ⟶
      DerivedCategory.Plus.ι.obj M) :
    ((((S.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj K).sc n).liftCycles
        (S.map (K.sc n).iCycles) (by
          change S.map (K.sc n).iCycles ≫ S.map (K.sc n).g = 0
          rw [← S.map_comp, (K.sc n).iCycles_g, S.map_zero])) ≫
      (((S.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj K).sc n).homologyπ ≫
      (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctorFactors D n).inv.app
        ((S.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj K) ≫
      (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor D n).map
        (S.rightDerivedFunctorUnit.app ((HomotopyCategory.quotient C (.up ℤ)).obj K)) ≫
      (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor D n).map (S.rightDerivedFunctor.map q) ≫
      (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor D n).map
        (S.rightDerivedFunctorPlusCompatibility.inv.app M) =
    S.rightDerivedPlusSingleUnitHomologyAt n ((K.sc n).cycles) ≫
      (DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor D n).map
        (S.rightDerivedFunctorPlus.map
          (DerivedCategory.Plus.ι.preimage
            (X := (DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor C n).obj ((K.sc n).cycles))
            (Y := M) (DerivedCategory.cyclesDerivedMap n K ≫ q)))
